pages.text: Install a cover and pages in your spell book. The pack's $(italic)Iridescent Modular Spells$() gives every ISS and Ars book module slots: front and back $(bold)covers$(), a $(bold)spine$() and $(bold)pages$() (an Ars book has a dye instead). The book's tier sets its bonus; the modules add a small fixed one.$(br2)Casters start with a modular Copper book; the Archmage also gets a modular Novice.

pages.title: ISS Tier (metal covers)
pages.text: $(item)Modular Copper$() (T1 entry): crafted from a copper book + leather (default).$(br)$(item)Modular Iron$() / $(item)Modular Gold$() (T2): iron / gold book + leather.$(br)$(item)Modular Diamond$() (T3): diamond book + leather.$(br)$(item)Modular Netherite$() (T4): netherite book + leather.$(br2)$(bold)Cover materials:$() leather (T1), copper, iron, gold, diamond, netherite (T4). A higher tier gives more; a cover's own bonus does not change.

pages.title: Ars Tier (cloth covers)
pages.text: $(item)Modular Novice$() (T1): novice book + white wool (default).$(br)$(item)Modular Apprentice$() (T2): apprentice book + white wool.$(br)$(item)Modular Archmage$() (T3): archmage book + white wool.$(br2)$(bold)Cloth covers:$() $(item)white wool$() (T1), then $(item)manaweave cloth$() (T2 Botania), $(item)sorcerer robes$() (T3 Ars) and $(item)spell cloth$() (T4 Botania endgame). Cloth bonuses go to Ars max mana and spell damage.

pages.title: Slot bonuses
pages.text: Whatever they are made of, the $(bold)back cover$() adds $(item)+20 max mana$() and the $(bold)spine$() $(item)+5% cooldown reduction$() ($(item)+5% mana regen$() on an Ars book). A cover of a magic material adds that material's own bonus: a ruby cover +5% spell power and +5% fire.$(br2)Bonuses add up across every book you carry in your main hand, offhand and curios.

pages.title: Custom enchants
pages.text: Modular books take four book-exclusive enchants from the enchanting table:$(br2)$(item)Mana Capacity$() I-V: +5% max mana per level (ISS and Ars).$(br)$(item)Mana Flow$() I-III: +5% mana regen per level.$(br)$(item)Arcane Edge$() I-III: +5% magic crit chance per level.$(br)$(item)Arcane Devastation$() I-III: +25% magic crit damage per level.$(br2)$(bold)Magic can crit$() once these enchants are on the book.

pages.title: Tier gates
pages.text: $(item)T1$(): Copper, Novice (start)$(br)$(item)T2$(): Iron, Gold, Apprentice$(br)$(item)T3$(): Diamond, Archmage$(br)$(item)T4$(): Netherite$(br2)Cover and pages materials follow their parent material's tier (a diamond cover needs T3, the tier at which diamond ore stops showing as plain stone).$(br2)$(bold)Next: check your starter book's tooltip. Its slots are already live.$()
